payload.task_text:
I need to prepare a department budget presentation for our upcoming board meeting. Please pull the current department headcount and budget data from the company HR data warehouse and create a PowerPoint presentation called HR_Department_Overview.pptx. The presentation should have at least seven slides: a title slide called HR Department Budget Overview, one slide per department showing the department name, headcount, budget, and location, and a final summary slide showing total headcount and total budget across all departments. Use the department names exactly as they appear in the data source (for example `HR` and `R&D`) — do not expand or rephrase them.

After creating the presentation, also create an Excel file called Department_Budget_Analysis.xlsx with a sheet called Department Summary that has columns Department, Headcount, Budget rounded to 2 decimals, Location, and Budget_Per_Employee which is the budget divided by headcount rounded to 2 decimals, sorted alphabetically by department name. Add a second sheet called Summary with Metric and Value columns showing Total_Headcount, Total_Budget, Avg_Budget_Per_Employee (computed as Total_Budget divided by Total_Headcount) rounded to 2 decimals, and Highest_Budget_Dept. Use these exact metric labels (with underscores) as the Metric values.

Then create a Google Sheet named 'HR Department Tracker' (create it if it does not already exist) and populate it with the same department data, and send an email to hr.directors@company.com with subject HR Department Budget Summary Q1 2026 containing a brief overview of the findings.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, the main agent should first query the complete department table once, preserve exact department names such as HR and R&D, compute headcount and budget controls, and freeze alphabetically sorted rows. Then create the three independent deliverables in one wave.

1. Wave 1 — dispatch exactly 3 coder sub-agents in parallel:

   1. coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): One coder sub-agent owns `HR_Department_Overview.pptx` under one presentation ID. Use the literal source labels as slide text—especially the exact three-character string `R&D`; never expand it to Research and Development. Create the title slide, one slide per returned department with exact name/headcount/budget/location, and the final numeric summary. Use one bounded populate operation per slide, save once, extract the full deck text once, and return the path, slide count/titles, literal department-name coverage, and total checks.

   2. coder 1 (office-report-builder 1): One coder sub-agent owns `Department_Budget_Analysis.xlsx` and writes the exact Department Summary and Summary sheets with literal values, alphabetical rows, Budget_Per_Employee, and the exact underscore metric labels. Use one bulk write per sheet and one read-back.

   3. coder 2 (external-workflow-operator 0): One coder sub-agent owns exactly one `HR Department Tracker` cloud spreadsheet. Search the exact title, create only if absent, write the same literal source labels and rows once, and read it back once.

After Wave 1, the main agent checks that all three outputs contain every exact department label including `R&D` and that the totals agree, then sends exactly one email to `hr.directors@company.com` with subject `HR Department Budget Summary Q1 2026`. Do not run row-by-row revalidation or dispatch another wave.

nodes.text:
Build a PowerPoint presentation named HR_Department_Overview.pptx and save it to the absolute path:
/workspace/dumps/kimi-code_DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731/SingleUserTurn-sf-hr-dept-budget-ppt-email/workspace/HR_Department_Overview.pptx
using the pptx MCP tools only.

BACKGROUND: The data comes from the company HR data warehouse table HR_ANALYTICS.PUBLIC.DEPARTMENTS. Department names must be used EXACTLY as they appear in the source — especially the literal string 'R&D' (three characters: R, &, D). NEVER expand or rephrase it (do NOT write "Research and Development" or anything else).

DEPARTMENT DATA (7 departments, in this order):
1. Engineering | Headcount 7096 | Budget 633555641.27 | Location New York
2. Finance | Headcount 7148 | Budget 616980984.11 | Location Sydney
3. HR | Headcount 7077 | Budget 697911374.65 | Location New York
4. Operations | Headcount 7120 | Budget 572668189.63 | Location Sydney
5. R&D | Headcount 7083 | Budget 715914847.42 | Location Singapore
6. Sales | Headcount 7232 | Budget 642575220.92 | Location New York
7. Support | Headcount 7244 | Budget 684741486.31 | Location Toronto

CONTROL TOTALS (for the final summary slide): Total headcount = 50000, Total budget = 4564347744.31.

REQUIRED SLIDES (9 total):
1. Title slide: title text 'HR Department Budget Overview' (subtitle optional, e.g. 'Board Meeting Briefing').
2-8. One slide per department (order above), each showing the department name (exact literal), headcount, budget, and location — e.g. slide title = department name, body = Headcount: 7096, Budget: 633555641.27, Location: New York. Use the exact values.
9. Final summary slide showing Total Headcount: 50000 and Total Budget: 4564347744.31.

IMPLEMENTATION GUIDANCE:
- Use the pptx MCP server: create_presentation to start, add slides (add_slide / create_slide_from_template), populate placeholders (populate_placeholder) or add text (manage_text) — one bounded populate operation per slide, do not add redundant boxes.
- Keep a single presentation (one presentation_id) throughout. Save exactly once at the end with save_presentation to the path above.
- After saving, extract the full deck text once with extract_presentation_text to verify content.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (verify before returning):
- File saved at the absolute path.
- 9 slides: 1 title + 7 department slides + 1 summary.
- Every exact department name appears in slide text: Engineering, Finance, HR, Operations, R&D, Sales, Support — confirm 'R&D' appears as the exact three-character string.
- Summary slide shows Total Headcount 50000 and Total Budget 4564347744.31.

RETURN: the absolute file path, slide count, the list of slide titles, confirmation that all 7 exact department names (including the literal 'R&D') appear in slide text, and the totals shown on the summary slide.

Build an Excel workbook named Department_Budget_Analysis.xlsx and save it to the absolute path:

using the excel MCP tools only.

BACKGROUND: Data comes from the company HR data warehouse table HR_ANALYTICS.PUBLIC.DEPARTMENTS. Department names must be used EXACTLY as they appear in the source — especially the literal string 'R&D' (three characters). NEVER expand or rephrase it.

DEPARTMENT DATA (already sorted alphabetically by department name; Budget_Per_Employee = budget/headcount rounded to 2 decimals — the values below are authoritative controls):
Engineering | Headcount 7096 | Budget 633555641.27 | New York | Budget_Per_Employee 89283.49
Finance | Headcount 7148 | Budget 616980984.11 | Sydney | Budget_Per_Employee 86315.19
HR | Headcount 7077 | Budget 697911374.65 | New York | Budget_Per_Employee 98616.84
Operations | Headcount 7120 | Budget 572668189.63 | Sydney | Budget_Per_Employee 80430.93
R&D | Headcount 7083 | Budget 715914847.42 | Singapore | Budget_Per_Employee 101075.09
Sales | Headcount 7232 | Budget 642575220.92 | New York | Budget_Per_Employee 88851.66
Support | Headcount 7244 | Budget 684741486.31 | Toronto | Budget_Per_Employee 94525.33

TOTALS: Total_Headcount = 50000; Total_Budget = 4564347744.31; Avg_Budget_Per_Employee = 91286.95 (4564347744.31/50000 rounded to 2); Highest_Budget_Dept = R&D.

WORKBOOK STRUCTURE (create_workbook at the path above):
Sheet 1 named 'Department Summary':
- Header row: Department | Headcount | Budget | Location | Budget_Per_Employee
- 7 data rows as listed above in alphabetical order. Budget and Budget_Per_Employee written as numeric values rounded to 2 decimals.
- Use ONE bulk write (write_data_to_excel) for the whole sheet.

Sheet 2 named 'Summary':
- Header row: Metric | Value
- Rows with EXACT metric labels (underscores):
  Total_Headcount | 50000
  Total_Budget | 4564347744.31
  Avg_Budget_Per_Employee | 91286.95
  Highest_Budget_Dept | R&D
- Use ONE bulk write for the whole sheet.

IMPLEMENTATION GUIDANCE:
- create_workbook, then rename the default worksheet to 'Department Summary' (rename_worksheet) or create worksheets and delete any leftover default sheet (delete_worksheet). Write sheet 1, create sheet 2, write sheet 2.
- One bulk write per sheet — do NOT write cell by cell.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (verify before returning):
- File saved at the absolute path.
- 'Department Summary' sheet: header Department, Headcount, Budget, Location, Budget_Per_Employee; 7 rows alphabetically ordered (Engineering, Finance, HR, Operations, R&D, Sales, Support) with 'R&D' literal; Budget and Budget_Per_Employee rounded to 2 decimals.
- 'Summary' sheet: the 4 exact metric labels with the control values.
- Read back both sheets once (read_data_from_excel) to confirm contents.

RETURN: the absolute file path, the read-back contents of both sheets (or confirmation they match spec exactly), confirmation that 'R&D' appears literally, and confirmation that Budget / Budget_Per_Employee are rounded to 2 decimals.

Create or reuse a Google Spreadsheet titled exactly 'HR Department Tracker' using the google_sheet MCP tools only, and populate it with department data from the company HR data warehouse.

STEPS:
1. Search for an existing spreadsheet with the exact title 'HR Department Tracker' — use search_spreadsheets (query 'HR Department Tracker') and/or list_spreadsheets. If exactly one match exists, USE IT (do not create a duplicate). If it does not exist, create it with create_spreadsheet(title='HR Department Tracker').
2. Populate the first sheet (rename it to 'Departments' if you like) with this data. Department names must be EXACT literals — especially 'R&D' (three characters: R, &, D). NEVER expand or rephrase.

ROWS (already in alphabetical order by department name):
Header: Department | Headcount | Budget | Location
Engineering | 7096 | 633555641.27 | New York
Finance | 7148 | 616980984.11 | Sydney
HR | 7077 | 697911374.65 | New York
Operations | 7120 | 572668189.63 | Sydney
R&D | 7083 | 715914847.42 | Singapore
Sales | 7232 | 642575220.92 | New York
Support | 7244 | 684741486.31 | Toronto

3. Write the data once (update_cells or batch_update_cells) — a single write, not cell-by-cell.
4. Read the sheet back once (get_sheet_data) to verify.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- Spreadsheet with exact title 'HR Department Tracker' exists; reused if pre-existing, created only if absent — never duplicated.
- First sheet contains the header and 7 data rows with exact department names including the literal 'R&D', and correct headcount/budget/location values.

RETURN: the spreadsheet ID, spreadsheet title, the sheet name where data was written, whether it was created or already existed, and the read-back contents.
